data.title: micro1 Announces $1 Billion Enterprise AI Data Commitment
data.description: In a recent announcement out of San Francisco, micro1, a data lab specializing in enhancing AI models and agents, revealed plans to invest $1 billion in the next year. This investment will be directed towards acquiring and licensing enterprise operational data under the Company Data Partnerships initiative. This program aims to provide businesses with an additional income source by leveraging the operational insights they have gathered over time. By utilizing de-identified company data, micro1 constructs reinforcement learning environments mirroring real-world business scenarios.

data.title: TEDC Honors President & CEO Carlton Schwab as He Announces Retirement After 28 Years of Service
data.description: In Austin, Texas, the Texas Economic Development Council (TEDC) revealed that President and CEO Carlton Schwab, who has helmed the organization since February 1999, will retire soon. With almost 28 years of service, Schwab leaves behind a significant impact as a key figure in Texas's economic development. His retirement was acknowledged at the TEDC's Annual Conference held in Houston from October 7 to 9, 2026. Schwab's leadership was praised for his substantial role in the organization.

data.title: AvionTEq Celebrates Successful MRO Asia-Pacific 2026 and Announces UTS100 Giveaway Winner
data.description: AvionTEq, a prominent global aviation test equipment and support solutions provider, recently wrapped up its successful participation in MRO Asia-Pacific 2026 at Singapore EXPO from September 22-24. The company took part in the event at Booth 2106, where it presented its latest innovations and services to attendees from the aviation industry. This included airlines, MRO organizations, manufacturers, maintenance providers, and aviation professionals from Asia-Pacific nations and beyond. The event provided an excellent platform for AvionTEq to engage with a wide audience.
